# openinfra_security_group (Resource)

A named set of firewall rules attachable to workloads and VMs. Compiles to NetworkPolicies; members are default-deny inbound once attached.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Resource name. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `egress` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--egress))
- `ingress` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ingress))
- `namespace` (String) Kubernetes namespace. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `namespace/name`, the import identifier.
- `member_label` (String) Pods carrying this label are members.
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the resource's Ready condition is True. Terraform returns as soon as the object is accepted, so this is usually `false` immediately after apply — the platform reconciles asynchronously.

<a id="nestedatt--egress"></a>
### Nested Schema for `egress`

Optional:

- `description` (String) Why this rule exists. Carried through to the NetworkPolicy.
- `ports` (List of Number) Ports to allow. Empty means all ports.
- `protocol` (String) `TCP` or `UDP`. Defaults to `TCP`.
- `to` (Attributes List) Destinations, OR'd together. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--egress--to))

<a id="nestedatt--egress--to"></a>
### Nested Schema for `egress.to`

Optional:

- `cidr` (String) An IP range, e.g. `10.0.0.0/8`.
- `namespace` (String) Every pod in a namespace.
- `security_group` (String) Another SecurityGroup, by name.



<a id="nestedatt--ingress"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ingress`

Optional:

- `description` (String) Why this rule exists. Carried through to the NetworkPolicy.
- `from` (Attributes List) Sources, OR'd together. Each entry is one of `cidr`, `security_group` or `namespace`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ingress--from))
- `ports` (List of Number) Ports to allow. Empty means all ports.
- `protocol` (String) `TCP` or `UDP`. Defaults to `TCP`.

<a id="nestedatt--ingress--from"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ingress.from`

Optional:

- `cidr` (String) An IP range, e.g. `10.0.0.0/8`.
- `namespace` (String) Every pod in a namespace.
- `security_group` (String) Another SecurityGroup, by name.
